title.zh-Hant: 更正 — 並無偵測到煙霧

instruction.en: The earlier smoke alert was reported in error by the sensor. No action is needed. We are sorry for the alarm this caused.
instruction.zh-Hant: 較早前的煙霧警報為感應器誤報。毋須採取行動。就此造成的驚擾，我們深感抱歉。

body.en: The sensor has been reset and is reporting normally.
body.zh-Hant: 感應器已重設並回復正常回報。

disclaimer.en: This alert supplements the building fire alarm and statutory emergency procedures. It does not replace them, and it may be delayed or unavailable.
disclaimer.zh-Hant: 此警報為輔助性質，不能取代大廈火警系統及法定緊急程序，並可能延遲或無法提供。

correctionNote.en: This corrects the alert sent at 09:42.
correctionNote.zh-Hant: 此訊息更正09:42發出的警報。
